text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list:
There must have been more I could've done, 
too...

Because there must have been more I 
could've done, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you dedicate so much of your time 
to mentoring me?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san has done more than enough for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There were plenty of chances during the 
race. Losing this time... was simply due 
to my own lack of skill.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: More, even more. I have to get stronger...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: More than anyone else, even further!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It might be a distant goal for me right 
now, but even so, without fail."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to lose to anyone when it comes 
to effort alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'll aim to be number one in training 
load. The heaviest weights, the longest 
distance, the longest time.
choice_data_list: And eventually, we'll take first place!
